articles.title: The 80C Basket Decision: What ₹1.5 L of Deductions Is Actually Worth in Your Regime (and the NPS Side-Door)

Worked 10-year comparison at 14% gross, the decision rule, and the 194LBB cash-flow trap.

Closes the surcharge/cess gap the Wave-9 deduction-shield model flagged.
